community: AU Schools SMP — Australian/Oceania Minecraft community
world_border: 50,000 blocks; radius versus diameter has not been specified
server_rules: No spamming text, emojis, images, or mentions.
No arguing with staff; staff decisions are final.
Use common sense at all times.
No hate speech, discrimination, or slurs.
No harassment, bullying, or toxic behavior.
Keep topics in their designated channels.
No loopholing or rules lawyering; the spirit of the rule matters.
Staff may punish actions not explicitly written in the rules.
No mini-modding; report rule breakers instead of acting as staff.
No alternate accounts to bypass bans, mutes, or restrictions.
No dynamic IP switching or VPNs to evade punishments.
No doxxing or distribution of personal information.
No flame-baiting or intentionally upsetting users.
No severe mic-spamming, screaming, or voice-changer abuse in voice channels.
No cross-server drama, raiding coordination, or outside fights.
gameplay_rules: Use common sense at all times.
No cheating, hacking, or exploiting glitches.
No banned mods; the full banned-mods list has not been supplied to this assistant.
No e-chesting loot or intentionally clearing inventory during or right before death.
Do not use elytras to escape combat or danger.
No griefing, stealing, or raiding unapproved areas.
No killing outside designated PvP zones or times.
No intentional lag machines or server crash attempts.
No stream-sniping, targeting, or harassing specific players.
No trap-killing at spawns, warps, or teleport destinations.
Do not use stasis chambers to escape combat; they may be used to escape danger.
custom_recipes: For custom recipes and how to craft them, check <#1563853562176344164>. Refer recipe questions to that channel; do not invent ingredients or crafting instructions.
